subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps — Acme Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Diaz <samantha.diaz@acme-commerce.com>; Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-commerce.com
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps — Acme Commerce

Hi Samantha / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation on use cases and where Redwood could help reduce inference costs and latency for your search & personalization pipelines. Quick recap and asks so we’re all aligned: 

- Demo highlights: dedicated capacity for predictable tail latency, prefix caching to reduce token costs, and routing fallbacks for DR.
- Primary use cases we discussed: product search ranking, personalized recommendations, and chat-assisted support triage.
- Next technical steps: Rishi (cc’d) to share a short sizing questionnaire + suggested model/quant config by end of next week.

What we need from your side to accelerate internal conversations: 
1) Stakeholder map / org chart for the teams involved (search, infra, security, procurement, and the economic buyer).
2) Procurement timeline and any required legal/security artifacts (SOC 2, data residency/KMS needs, standard NC NDAs).
3) Any decision criteria or evaluation checklist you typically use for inference vendors (SLA/cost/throughput/security priorities).

If you can share an org chart or a simple list of names + roles for the above, we’ll draft a one-page mutual action plan and timeline that aligns with your procurement windows.

Proposed next call: 30 min week of Dec 13 to introduce Rishi (SE) and walk requirements matrix. Is Thurs 12/16 at 10am PT an option?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: none in this message.

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Attaching the org chart and a short requirements matrix (see attachments). A few notes from our side: 

- Org/decision makers: I’m the PM owner for personalization initiatives; Raj is the head of Search/IR and will own technical sign-off. The economic buyer will be our VP of Product (Karen Liu) plus final approval from Finance for committed spend.
- Security & legal: our security team requires SOC 2 Type II, encryption at rest with KMS integration, and an inventory of data flows for logging/audit. I’m looping procurement so they see the ask early.
- Procurement timeline: provisional review this month; final internal procurement approval targeted for the week of Jan 10, 2027.

Attachments (stubs): acme_org_chart_v2.pdf (2 pages) — high-level org chart; requirements_matrix.xlsx (sheet: "redwood-eval")

We can do Thu 12/16 10am PT for the intro call. Add your SE and any security folks.

Thanks,
Samantha Diaz
Senior Product Manager — Personalization
Acme Commerce
samantha.diaz@acme-commerce.com
